summary: Kanzhun Ltd (Boss Zhipin) filed a Form 6-K presenting a Next Day Disclosure Return for the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. The filing details open-market share repurchases across multiple trading days from May 27 to June 15, 2026, at average prices between USD 6.67 and 7.25 per share, and the exercise of 14,250 share options at USD 4.3435 per share. All repurchased shares are held for cancellation. The issuer acts as the buyer returning capital to shareholders through a buyback program. Watch for continued execution of the repurchase authorization and potential reduction in share count.
